split_policy.primary_axis: parser fixture role before fixture path convenience, diagnostic sidecar, snapshot, docs/index row, or retired-surface tag
split_policy.positive_rule: parser positives are hand-authored tests/native/parser/positive fixtures with canonical_behavior_source=true and retired_positive_surface=false
split_policy.docs_evidence_rule: owner index rows, phase contracts, and diagnostic snapshots are provenance unless tied to a parser fixture sidecar
split_policy.rejection_rule: old-mode, compatibility-shim, fallback, generated-only, evidence-log, and migration-only parser rows are rejection or provenance-only evidence
split_policy.omitted_phase_rule: this family has no sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e behavior contracts
